responsibilities.id: Merancang dan membangun aplikasi web sistem informasi klinik dan tata kelola pergudangan menggunakan React, Laravel, dan MySQL.
responsibilities.en: Architecting and developing clinic medical records and warehouse management web systems using React, Laravel, and MySQL.

responsibilities.id: Mengembangkan aplikasi mobile presensi berbasis React Native dengan verifikasi lokasi GPS dan sinkronisasi REST API.
responsibilities.en: Developing cross-platform mobile attendance apps in React Native with GPS geofencing verification and backend REST API synchronization.

responsibilities.id: Mengoptimalkan query basis data dan struktur relasi untuk memastikan respon aplikasi tetap cepat saat data bertumbuh.
responsibilities.en: Optimizing relational database queries and indices to maintain fast query response times under growing data loads.

responsibilities.id: Mengonversi desain antarmuka menjadi kode antarmuka web yang responsif, modular, dan ramah aksesibilitas.
responsibilities.en: Translating UI designs into responsive, modular, and accessible component code.

responsibilities.id: Melakukan integrasi REST API backend ke dalam komponen frontend serta menangani validasi formulir pengguna.
responsibilities.en: Integrating backend REST APIs into frontend workflows while implementing resilient user form validation.

responsibilities.id: Mengelola pemeliharaan rutin dan perbaikan bug pada sistem aplikasi web klien.
responsibilities.en: Handling regular maintenance, browser compatibility tests, and bug fixes across client web applications.
